sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: Which of these objects has a bumpy and rough texture?
What color is mostly used as the background when painting an ocean scene in the Aqua World?
When making an arrangement of objects like a fruit bowl, what should you do first?
options: C) Erase holes in the paper

questions.question_text: How do you show a person in action who is running fast?
options: B) Legs bent and spread apart
questions.answer: B) Legs bent and spread apart

questions.question_text: Which geometric shape best describes a tall city building when you look around?
If you paint a picture of a flying car, what kind of art are you creating?
Which natural object found outside usually feels very smooth?
Which of these animals would you draw in an Aqua World artwork?
Which musical instrument do you strike with sticks to make a sound?
What happens when you let your colors explore by mixing red and yellow paint?
Describe the difference in texture between a pineapple and a smooth apple. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A pineapple has a rough, prickly, and bumpy texture on the outside. In contrast, an apple feels very smooth, hard, and shiny when you touch its skin.

questions.question_text: What body parts change position when you draw a person jumping instead of standing still? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: When drawing a jumping person, the legs bend at the knees and lift off the ground, while the arms usually reach up high into the air.

questions.question_text: Why is it important to look carefully at an arrangement of objects before you start drawing them? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Looking carefully helps you see the correct shapes, sizes, and shadows. It makes sure your drawing looks exactly like the real arrangement of objects in front of you.

questions.question_text: Name three creatures you would draw in an underwater scene and mention the colors you would use for them. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: I would draw a bright orange starfish, a glowing pink jellyfish, and a dark green sea turtle swimming through the deep blue ocean water.

questions.question_text: How can you use natural materials from outside to create interesting art? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: You can collect dry leaves, twigs, and colorful flower petals to glue onto a piece of paper, creating beautiful nature collages and highly textured patterns.

questions.question_text: Imagine a magical tree that grows unusual things instead of regular leaves. Describe what its branches and colors look like. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: The magical tree has a sparkling silver trunk. Instead of green leaves, it grows tiny glowing lanterns in neon blue and pink colors. The branches twist like curly ribbons, and golden bells hang down from them, chiming softly whenever the wind blows.

questions.question_text: Look around your imaginary dream bedroom. Describe the colors, shapes, and textures you see inside it. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: My dream bedroom has walls painted in a soft, calming lavender color. The bed has a giant, fluffy white blanket that feels like a soft cloud. On the floor, there is a smooth, shiny wooden carpet shaped exactly like giant puzzle pieces.

questions.question_text: Describe how you would create a detailed clay model of a person playing basketball. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: I would start by rolling clay to form a strong body and two long legs bent at the knees to show movement. I would shape one arm stretching high up, holding a round, orange clay ball. The person’s head would tilt upward, looking at an imaginary hoop, showing the action of shooting the basketball.

questions.question_text: Describe the facial expressions and body movements of someone who has just opened a box and found a hidden treasure. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: The person would have wide open eyes and a massive, joyful smile to show extreme surprise and happiness. They would throw their hands up high in the air and jump excitedly on their toes. Their whole body would shake with incredible energy as they celebrate finding the shiny golden treasure.
